'''Premiere &ndash; Tatooine''' (display name '''Premiere - Tatooine'''; GEMP code <code>premiere_tatooine</code>) is a constructed environment whose legal pool is the printed Decipher sets from [[Premiere]] through [[Tatooine (expansion)|Tatooine]].

The [[2001 Brugge Belgian Open]] was played in this format (Tatooine cards are on those lists). The [[2001 Decipher World Championship]] used [[Premiere - Reflections III]], not this pool. On [https://play.swccg.com/ play.swccg.com]<ref name="play">[https://play.swccg.com/ play.swccg.com], GEMP. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009095947/https://play.swccg.com/ Internet Archive].</ref> it covers set ids 1&ndash;11 plus premium/reflections ids 101&ndash;112.

{| class="wikitable"

| 60 cards
|}
